scope: Existing purple wrist mount for both arms, plus camera/electronics proxies in assembly.xml

mesh_units.components: metres in source camera geometry body frame; placement is in package-root mjcf/wrist_mount_v8.xml

target_attachment: Combined legacy_jaw STL coordinates equal the target canonical MJCF Fixed_Jaw/Fixed_Jaw_2 body coordinates. URDF Fixed_Jaw visuals retain tiny conversion-rounding origins (up to 1.2 micrometres); copy the side-specific visual origin when exact URDF mesh alignment is required.
matrix_convention: parent_T_child maps child coordinates into parent; translation in metres
camera_cv_axes: +X image right, +Y image down, +Z optical forward
camera_optics: Approximate geometry-derived frame. Keep the teammate hand-eye calibration separate and compare transforms; this export does not replace measured extrinsics or intrinsics.
assembly_camera_pose_source: Active v8 camera-registration.json, not stale nominal camera/site orientation embedded in source bench.xml.
assembly_camera_intrinsics_note: Viewer camera retains the source nominal fovy for geometry inspection; calibrated intrinsics and lens distortion are not exported into this MJCF camera.
assumptions: Plate tilt 45 degrees from photographs, not directly measured
Foot placement relative to fixed jaw, foot dimensions, case thickness, lens depth and component mass remain approximate
Preserve CAD support-box/mast relative geometry while translating central assembly
limitations: No original editable CAD or STEP exists for this reconstructed asset.
Merged STL is a triangle concatenation of ten box components, not a boolean-unioned watertight manufacturing solid.
Fastener holes, exact wall thickness, material and mass properties were not measured.
The original v8 inertia and collision proxies are retained in assembly.xml; mass is assumed.
Lens, connector, cable and screw proxies are omitted from the purple-only merged STL.
No hardware or active training model was changed.

provenance.original_generator: build_bench_photo_camera_mount.py; source parameter description retained under parameters_m
provenance.export_method: Original component STL bytes copied; ten purple components rigidly transformed from the camera geometry body into the legacy fixed-jaw mesh frame and concatenated. The mm variant scales all vertices by 1000.
provenance.asset_license: Apache-2.0, matching the cleany_description package declaration.
